items.title: A Public Health Doctor Isn’t An ‘Office Doctor’ — Dr MFH
items.summary: Public Health Medicine is sometimes misunderstood as admin work. But the office is only one working base. The medicine happens across communities, clinics, hospitals, laboratories, workplaces, schools and other agencies. TB shows the difference clearly. The post A Public Health Doctor Isn’t An ‘Office Doctor’ — Dr MFH appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: MMA Sabah: Only 34% Of Medical Officers Showed Up For Hospital Postings
items.summary: MMA Sabah says only 34% of medical officers from outside Sabah posted to hospitals in the state had reported for duty (47 out of 138). If this 66% no-show rate persists till Oct 7, it will exceed the deputy health minister's earlier 50% no-show projection. The post MMA Sabah: Only 34% Of Medical Officers Showed Up For Hospital Postings appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Report For Duty By Oct 7, MOH Urges Doctors Amid Early No-Shows
items.summary: MOH urges medical officers to report for duty at their new placements by Oct 7, saying the process is still ongoing and that people shouldn't draw any "premature conclusions" yet. The second phase of permanent appointments this year involves 4,255 doctors. The post Report For Duty By Oct 7, MOH Urges Doctors Amid Early No-Shows appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: What I Owe The Next Houseman — Dr Kamal Amzan
items.summary: Housemen need supervisors who know their progress, are available when decisions exceed their competence, and can explain what improvement looks like. Those supervisors need time and support too. The post What I Owe The Next Houseman — Dr Kamal Amzan appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Sarawakian Bidayuh Suffer Highest Rates Of Nasopharyngeal Cancer Worldwide: Experts
items.summary: Experts say the Bidayuh community in Sarawak has the highest rates of nasopharyngeal cancer (NPC) globally. High NPC risk for the indigenous group is linked to genetic factors, EBV infection, environmental hazards, and consumption of salted preserved food. The post Sarawakian Bidayuh Suffer Highest Rates Of Nasopharyngeal Cancer Worldwide: Experts appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Revert To Percentage-Based BIW Allowance, Give Relocation Assistance Before Doctors Relocate — MMA
items.summary: MMA is deeply concerned over doctor no-shows in Sabah and Sarawak. If contract MOs are refusing permanent positions, it points to deeper problems that can't be ignored. Restore BIW allowance's progressive structure and provide relocation assistance prior. items.title: Borneo’s Doctor No-Show ‘Crisis’ Indicates Retention Problem: Warisan
items.summary: Doctor no-shows for permanent posts in Sabah and Sarawak, ranging from 70% to 100% in certain facilities, are a "crisis" that should become a turning point for Malaysia's health care workforce recruitment, remuneration, and retention, says a Warisan rep. items.title: Rare Opportunity To Break Through Silos Hindering Mental Health Policies — Dr Kelvin Yii, Lim Yi Wei & Michelle Ng
items.summary: Before NSFIRM, Malaysia lacked a comprehensive, systematic registry of suicide deaths and attempts. NSFIRM can help draw this picture through systematic analysis and incident trend monitoring. items.title: Peka B40 Screenings Reveal Undiagnosed Conditions Among Almost Half Of Participants
items.summary: Nearly 46% of 328,302 people screened by Peka B40 last year had either at least one previously undiagnosed NCD, identified as being at risk of anxiety or depression, or both. Peka B40 screening uptake as of Aug 31 varied from 15% in KL to 46% in Kelantan. items.title: Pantai Hospital KL Pioneers Mahjong Programme To Help Curb Alzheimer’s
items.summary: Pantai Hospital KL is the first hospital to integrate competitive social mahjong into a clinical brain health programme, offering participants a unique combination of expert medical dialogue, digital cognitive assessments, and interactive social gameplay.
